description.value: The Kitsilano branch of Whole Foods Market is a full-service natural and organic supermarket on West 4th Avenue, one of Vancouver's most heavily cycled arterials. Beyond the broad grocery selection spanning organic produce, sustainable seafood, and specialty packaged goods, the store hosts four in-house eateries including a coffee bar, sandwich counter, burrito bar, and juice bar. It is a well-stocked resupply point in a neighbourhood with strong cycling infrastructure.
